integrity: The arithmetic density formula is proved analytically from the source high-energy condition and independently replayed by an exact-rational interval checker. No numerical fit is used to establish the formula.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the quarter-flux class \(A\equiv 1/4\pmod{1/2}\) in the tight-chain model; arbitrary flux is not evaluated.
The result concerns the limiting momentum-band density obtained from the high-energy band condition; finite-energy band locations and widths are not classified.
The \(O(k^{-2})\) reduction from the exact secular condition is taken from the primary source and its use for density is justified by periodic sign stability away from finitely many zeros per period.
title: Exact quarter-flux momentum-band density for commensurate magnetic ring chains
